intro.text: A world devastated by a catastrophe.
The innermost planet of the Rosharan system, formerly called Alaswha.

description.text: Before its devastation, Ashyn supported pigs, rats, minks, parrots and domestic dogs.
Its landscape included the Central Sea and floating stones. The planet has tones distinct from Roshar's.

items.text: Adonalsium created the planet, and humans settled it before the Shards arrived in the system. Its inhabitants developed a collection of city-states.
Odium backed an expanding empire. Honor offered power to Nale and Makibak's opposing coalition.
Centuries of warfare with unrestricted Surges devastated the world. Its name changed to Ashyn in reference to the burning.
Refugees escaped to Roshar through Elsecalling strengthened by Ishar's Bondsmith powers. Odium accompanied the migration.
